rows.name: Arkansas State Medical Board
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Arkansas's physicians. Fifteen members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — ten physicians, a physician assistant, and public members across the four congressional districts (A.C.A. 17-95-301).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Arkansas Code; AR publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Arkansas State Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Arkansas's nurses. Thirteen members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, psychiatric technician nurses, and a consumer member (A.C.A. 17-87-203).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Arkansas Code; AR publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission
rows.mandate: Sets wildlife and fisheries policy for Arkansas — a constitutional commission. Seven voting commissioners appointed by the Governor to staggered seven-year terms, one from each congressional district (Ark. Const. Amend. 35).
rows.criticalNote: Seven governor-appointed voting commissioners (plus one non-voting ex officio); curated from the Arkansas Constitution

rows.name: Arkansas Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Arkansas's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — three licensees plus consumer and elderly representatives (A.C.A. 17-42-201).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Arkansas Code; AR publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Arkansas State Board of Pharmacy
rows.constituent: Arkansas patients & licensed pharmacists · drug safety
rows.mandate: Licenses pharmacists and regulates pharmacy practice in Arkansas. Eight members appointed by the Governor — five practicing pharmacists, a minority pharmacist member, and consumer and elderly representatives (A.C.A. 17-92-201).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Arkansas Code; AR publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
